benchmark.conclusion: No measured total-cost improvement on these small workloads. CPU RHF small-to-large saves 3 target Fock builds (11 to 8), but the complete source/projection/target workflow costs more.

identity_boundary: Source identity covers native/API/Python implementation and codegen; benchmark/test/docs files are retained separately. Measurements precede the implementation commit.
limitations: Native CPU overlap and NumPy metric projection are explicit host setup, including CUDA targets.
RHF/UHF real all-electron state transport only; no DFT/ROHF/ECP or correlated amplitude transport.
CUDA physical Fock counts and per-iteration solver histories are unavailable.
Final target density/energy/force equivalence is tested; no global HF stability or ground-state proof is claimed.
Numeric workspace budget excludes caller-owned HF arenas and BLAS/Python allocator internals.

cpu_python.skip_boundary: existing optional batch features, not projection cases
